title: Holzapfel 2005 AF fibre angle vs circumferential position and depth

quantity.name: fibre angle
quantity.definition: absolute fibre angle to the horizontal (transverse) plane, photogrammetry; positions A (ventral midsagittal) to F (dorsal midsagittal); regression |phi| = 23.2 + 0.130*polar angle (r2=0.55)

source.authors: Holzapfel GA, Schulze-Bauer CAJ, Feigl G, Regitnig P
source.sample: 11 lumbar body-disc-body units from 11 cadavers (6 grade I, 5 grade II); single-lamella specimens VLe n=11, VLi n=9, De n=11, Di n=8, cross-fibre n=7; fibre angles from the second hemidisc

protocol.summary: Fibre angles from the second hemidisc measured photogrammetrically at 6 circumferential positions and 3 depth levels
how_to_simulate: Compare model fibre angles (absolute, to the transverse plane) per position and depth
